title: What Is an Electrostatic Chuck (ESC)? Why Wafers Stick and How Temperature Is Controlled
excerpt: Why do semiconductor wafers stick to the equipment? The role of electrostatic chucks and temperature control. The semiconductors in smartphones and cars are made by moving thin, disk-shaped wafers in and out of equipment again and again.
